acceptance_criteria.criterion: repo-status-cells.js exports buildRepoStatusCells, makeBranchTrigger, and updateRepoStatusCells as named ES module exports.
buildRepoStatusCells returns an object with branchCell, badgeCell, and actionsCell properties, each being an HTMLTableCellElement (<td>).
Each returned cell carries the correct CSS class: branchCell → .repo-branch-cell, badgeCell → .repo-badge-cell, actionsCell → .repo-actions-cell.
The badge wrapper <div> inside badgeCell retains the data-repo-id attribute.
makeBranchTrigger returns a <button> with class branch-switch-trigger, the correct textContent, and aria-label.
updateRepoStatusCells locates and updates branch and badge cells within a <tr> by CSS class (not by hardcoded cell index), using the same rebuild logic as the current updateStatusTable.
When isStable is false and onBranchCellClick is provided, the branch cell contains a clickable trigger button; when isStable is true, it renders plain text.
The Git GUI button calls api.workspaces.launch.githubDesktop(projectId, wid, repoId).
The Browse button is conditionally rendered when webserverUrl is truthy, opening the correct URL pattern.
No innerHTML assignments — all text set via textContent.

summary: Created gui/public/js/components/repo-status-cells.js — a new shared component exporting buildRepoStatusCells, makeBranchTrigger, and updateRepoStatusCells as named ES module exports.
buildRepoStatusCells returns { branchCell, badgeCell, actionsCell } — each a <td> with the required CSS class (repo-branch-cell, repo-badge-cell, repo-actions-cell).
badgeCell contains a <div data-repo-id> wrapper so polling updates can locate badge content without touching the rest of the row.
makeBranchTrigger builds a <button class='branch-switch-trigger'> with correct textContent and aria-label; click handler wired by caller.
updateRepoStatusCells locates the branch cell via .repo-branch-cell class selector and the badge wrapper via div[data-repo-id] — no hardcoded cell-index dependency.
isStable flag governs branch cell: clickable trigger button when false + onBranchCellClick provided; plain textContent otherwise.
Git GUI button calls api.workspaces.launch.githubDesktop(projectId, wid, repoId); re-enables itself after success or failure.
Browse button rendered only when webserverUrl is truthy; inserted before Git GUI; opens the correct URL pattern via window.open.
No innerHTML assignments anywhere in the component — all text set via textContent or createTextNode (via status-badge.js).
Written test file gui/public/js/components/repo-status-cells.test.mjs with 19 tests covering all 10 acceptance criteria.
All 68 GUI tests pass (19 new + 49 pre-existing) — zero regressions.

comments.note: workspace-detail.js updateStatusTable still uses row.cells[1] (hardcoded index) to find the branch cell. Now that updateRepoStatusCells exists with the CSS-class approach, updateStatusTable in workspace-detail.js is a refactor candidate: it should delegate to updateRepoStatusCells instead of duplicating the logic. This is out of scope for WP-001 but should be tracked.

repo-status-cells.js imports showToast lazily (dynamic import inside the Git GUI click handler) to avoid a circular dependency. A cleaner approach would be to accept an optional onError callback parameter in buildRepoStatusCells so callers can inject their own error handling — this also makes unit testing the error path easier without needing a module mock.

workspace-detail.js uses innerHTML = '' to clear cell content in updateStatusTable (lines 316, 330) while the new component uses the removeChild loop pattern. The project does not have a documented convention for DOM clearing; a shared helper (e.g. clearElement(el)) would make the preferred pattern explicit.

summary: All 19 WP-001 unit tests pass. Full GUI regression suite (38 tests total) passes with zero failures. All 10 acceptance criteria verified by direct test execution and manual edge-case probing.

Edge-case 1 — Special chars in repoId (slashes, spaces): CSS.escape correctly escapes slashes and spaces in updateRepoStatusCells querySelector; Browse button encodes all path segments via encodeURIComponent; data-repo-id attribute stores value verbatim. PASS.

Edge-case 2 — AC6 index-independence deep check: Confirmed that updateRepoStatusCells leaves the prepended name cell (index 0) completely untouched; branch updated from 'main' to 'hotfix/urgent' via .repo-branch-cell class selector; badge wrapper retained and refreshed; row cell count unchanged. PASS.

Edge-case 3 — Git GUI error path with lazy toast import: api.workspaces.launch.githubDesktop throws → button disabled during call → re-enabled and label restored in finally block → showToast imported lazily renders a .toast-error div in #toast-container. Verified in isolation. PASS.

Edge-case 4 — updateRepoStatusCells graceful degradation: Empty row (no matching cells) → no-op, no throw. Row with only branch cell → branch updated, no throw. Row with only badge wrapper → badge refreshed, no throw. null statusInfo → branch cell shows em-dash fallback. PASS.

comments.note: The existing unit test for AC6 index-independence (nameFirst=true row) is correctly structured — calling updateRepoStatusCells with onBranchCellClick=null and isStable=false forces the 'no callback' plain-text path. Manually verified that the CSS-class selector approach works for rows with any number of leading cells. No issue.

Browse URL test covers the basic encodeURIComponent path but does not include IDs containing slashes ('/'). Additional QA probe confirms encodeURIComponent encodes slashes as %2F in the Browse URL path segments. No bugs found; this is a low-priority test coverage gap the Developer noted.

Lazy toast import in the Git GUI error handler (dynamic import('./components/toast.js')) works correctly in isolation — showToast renders .toast-error in #toast-container. Integration context (workspace-detail.js) was not tested here as it is out of scope for WP-001, but there is no evidence of a circular dependency issue.

updateRepoStatusCells gracefully handles partial/empty rows (querySelector returns null → guard clauses prevent any throw). This defensive behaviour is good but is not explicitly tested in the suite — consider adding a no-op regression test.

[documentation-forward] The module-level JSDoc for repo-status-cells.js is good, but updateRepoStatusCells' JSDoc is missing a @param entry for the implicit row.dataset.repoName fallback: when repoName is absent from the row's dataset, repoId is used as the aria-label suffix. Document this fallback in the JSDoc for updateRepoStatusCells.

[documentation-forward] The @param for opts.webserverUrl in buildRepoStatusCells says 'When truthy, a Browse button is prepended before the Git GUI button' — the word 'prepended' is accurate in DOM-insertion terms (insertBefore) but may confuse readers who interpret 'prepend' as adding before the actionsCell. Consider rewording to: 'When truthy, a Browse button is inserted before the Git GUI button inside actionsCell.'
